sections.hypothesis: Monthly rotation across BTC, ETH and SOL (the 180-day lookback) beats BTC held on a year it has never been run on: 2025-11 to 2026-10, the holdout.
sections.rationale: On watch since 2026-11-15 (Luke). Over 2018-01 to 2025-10 it was the only YouTube strategy to beat BTC held (Sharpe 1.25 vs 0.74 at 180 days), but most of that lead came from holding ETH and SOL in 2021: it beat BTC in only 3 of 11 walk-forward windows, its drawdown was -59% and its deflated Sharpe 42%. Unseen data is the one test that can't be fitted. Two honest limits, stated before the run: (1) this holdout year is already known to have fallen (BTC -29%, ETH -41% in the earlier holdout tests), so it was chosen for a holdout knowing a 200-day filter would likely keep it partly in cash; the falling-year rule compares returns at the same exposure, which removes most of that advantage, but not the choice. (2) The note it comes from was rejected on its scorecard; a pass here would support watching it, not reverse that rejection or count as a pass of the scorecard.
sections.rules: Implementation monthly-rotation: lookback_days 180 (the middle of the three tested, which survived walk-forward: out-of-sample Sharpe 1.51, 124% of in-sample; chosen over 90 because 90 and 180 were nearly identical and 180 is less tuned), trend_days 200, top_n 2. The coin universe, daily bars, 330 USDT, costs from kestrel.toml. Warm-up from 2024-11-01 so the 180-day ranks and 200-day averages are running when the holdout starts; scored from 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31. A position held on 2025-11-01 carries in at that day's mark. Command: kestrel holdout-test UNIVERSE --strategy monthly-rotation --research <this note> --warmup-start 2024-11 --start 2025-11 --end 2026-10 --param lookback_days=180.
sections.falsification: Scored on 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31 only, against BTC held over the same days (the benchmark its backtests use). Passes only if both hold: (1) the edge: if BTC held has a positive Sharpe over the year, the strategy's Sharpe is at least BTC's; if BTC's Sharpe is zero or negative (a falling year), the strategy's return beats BTC held at the strategy's average exposure; (2) its worst drawdown inside the year is no deeper than 50%. Run once; the result is recorded in data/holdout and decisions.toml whatever it is.
sections.parameters: lookback_days 180, trend_days 200, top_n 2. Nothing else is chosen.
sections.costs: About 22 bps a round trip on BTC and ETH, wider on SOL by its spread band; a few changes a month-end at most. Holdout runs are never trials.
